## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Converter changes include a fixture in `tests/fixtures/parity`,
      `tests/fixtures/parity-yaml` or `tests/fixtures/fixed`
- [ ] Swagger-exact output still matches converter.swagger.io
- [ ] No new network calls, tracking, storage or third-party scripts
- [ ] No real or internal API specs in fixtures or screenshots
